## 1. Libraries

```{r libraries}
# Minimal set for what this Rmd currently does
pkgs <- c("knitr", "readr", "dplyr", "ggplot2")

missing <- pkgs[!vapply(pkgs, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]
if (length(missing) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing packages: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "),
    "\nInstall with: install.packages(c(",
    paste0('"', missing, '"', collapse = ", "),
    "))"
  )
}

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Optional (only keep if you add code that uses them)
# library(correlation)
# library(MASS)
# library(ggeffects)
# library(insight)
# library(interactions)
```

## 2. Data Import

```{r import-data}
# Try a few likely paths depending on whether knit starts in plotting/ or the project root
candidates <- c(
  "extractions-retest-copy.csv",
  "plotting/extractions-retest-copy.csv",
  "code/plotting/extractions-retest-copy.csv"
)
data_path <- candidates[file.exists(candidates)][1]
if (is.na(data_path)) {
  stop("Could not find extractions-retest-copy.csv. Tried: ", paste(candidates, collapse = ", "))
}

df <- readr::read_csv(data_path, show_col_types = FALSE)

# Standardize names so hyphenated columns become dot-style names (e.g., "cope-17" -> "cope.17")
names(df) <- make.names(names(df), unique = TRUE)

# Make sure sex behaves as a categorical predictor
if ("sex" %in% names(df)) df$sex <- factor(df$sex)
```

## 3. Model + Plot

```{r model}
# Helper: create demeaned versions if they don't already exist
demean_if_needed <- function(dat, raw, demeaned) {
  if (demeaned %in% names(dat)) return(dat)

  if (raw %in% names(dat)) {
    dat[[demeaned]] <- dat[[raw]] - mean(dat[[raw]], na.rm = TRUE)
    return(dat)
  }

  stop(
    "Missing both '", raw, "' and '", demeaned, "'.\n",
    "Available columns matching '", raw, "':\n  ",
    paste(grep(raw, names(dat), value = TRUE), collapse = "\n  ")
  )
}

# Create demeaned covariates expected by the model (only if needed)
df <- demean_if_needed(df, "age", "age_demeaned")
df <- demean_if_needed(df, "avg_tsnr", "avg_tsnr_demeaned")
df <- demean_if_needed(df, "avg_fdmean", "avg_fdmean_demeaned")
df <- demean_if_needed(df, "flip", "flip_demeaned")
df <- demean_if_needed(df, "study", "study_demeaned")
df <- demean_if_needed(df, "Fwin_minus_Swin_z", "Fwin_minus_Swin_z_demeaned")

# These names match AFTER make.names() is applied above
resp   <- "brain.nii.gz_model.Fwin.Swin_type.act_cope.17_cname.rew_F.S.txt"
varcol <- "var_brain.nii.gz_model.Fwin.Swin_type.act_cope.17_cname.rew_F.S.txt"

if (!resp %in% names(df)) {
  stop(
    "Response column not found: ", resp, "\nClosest matches:\n  ",
    paste(grep("brain\\.nii\\.gz.*cope\\.17", names(df), value = TRUE), collapse = "\n  ")
  )
}
if (!varcol %in% names(df)) {
  stop(
    "Variance column not found: ", varcol, "\nClosest matches:\n  ",
    paste(grep("var_brain.*cope\\.17", names(df), value = TRUE), collapse = "\n  ")
  )
}

# Create weights as 1/variance (guard against 0)
w <- 1 / pmax(df[[varcol]], .Machine$double.eps)

model1 <- lm(
  df[[resp]] ~ age_demeaned + sex + avg_tsnr_demeaned + avg_fdmean_demeaned +
    flip_demeaned + study_demeaned + Fwin_minus_Swin_z_demeaned +
    age_demeaned * Fwin_minus_Swin_z_demeaned,
  data = df,
  weights = w
)

summary(model1)
```

```{r plot}
ggplot(df, aes(x = age, y = .data[[resp]])) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
  labs(x = "Age", y = "β", title = "") +
  theme_minimal()
```
